The home interceptor10 then rolls5-8 and fails; its four tackle-zone modifiers belong to42/38/39/44 and its Disturbing Presence modifier belongs to44. Role ownership differs between the two checks. QuestionInterceptors Gamer0/PassType4/PassModifier-3 is a controller reaction within the away pass, not an ordinary new home team turn. UI next displays the loose ball at[6,9] and home Turn8. The separate EndTurn raw Reason2 is retained, but no specific textual reason was independently read here. Pre-state308/3 has Carrier46/IsHeld1 at[15,10]; intermediate309/5 retains Carrier46 at[6,8] with IsHeld omitted during the interceptor choice; final311/6 omits both at[6,9]. cases.notes: Two separately displayed Block actions fail Foul Appearance2+ with die1, then different teammates act in the same away Turn8 before the pass in UI-098. They are not repeated emissions of a single attempt and neither observed failure ends the team turn. In the raw before/after snapshots, actor42 changes from explicit CanAct1/MovePoint4/Gfi2 to omitting those fields after254; actor44 independently changes from CanAct1/MovePoint5/Gfi2 to omission after255. SequenceType2 appears for each spent block action while positions and TackleZone1 persist. The home subject10 owns Skill10 and remains explicit CanAct1; attributing its skill use as the roller or treating each failure as a team turnover would be wrong. The observed subsequent activations provide a concrete negative turnover case; omission alone is not promoted to a universal false/default rule or proof of every remaining legal action. Deterministic movement for43 and stand-up37 are retained only at the selected activation/stand-up context; no independent movement probability is scored.
